topic: Brain has no pain receptors: awake brain surgery, headache origin
caption:
Your brain processes every pain signal in your body, yet it can't feel pain itself. Brain tissue has no pain receptors, which is why some patients stay awake and talk during brain surgery so surgeons can map speech areas.

The headache you feel comes from the tissue around your brain, not the brain itself. Part 2 tomorrow: where headache pain really starts. Follow so you don't miss it.

Would you agree to stay awake during brain surgery?
